description: The identity of one packed owner release: the package it carries, the version the package half bumped to, the sha512 digest of the tarball, the branch-relative path of that tarball, and the package commit it was packed from. It is what crosses between an owner route and a consumer route: a library.update branch under mode publish writes it beside its archive, and a library.update branch under mode consume reads it as its input. publication says where that archive now lives: published names the registry that serves this exact version, the integrity it serves — the archive's own — and the moment it began to; pending is the record of an archive that was packed and not published, which is what a request that preset publish false asked for and what a run inside one checkout leaves behind.
